title: Divers Found a 2,000-Year-Old Computer at the Bottom of the Sea
caption: In 1901, divers pulled a corroded bronze lump from an ancient shipwreck off the Greek island of Antikythera. Inside were gears that tracked the Sun, Moon, planets and eclipses. Nothing this complex appears again for more than a thousand years. #antikythera #antikytheramechanism #ancientgreece #history #mystery #science #shorts
